description: Changelog of code changes, newest last. One entry per logical change; a single commit may carry more than one when the same files are touched. Kept alongside git history so the record is readable without git.

entries.author: Claude (Cowork session)
entries.summary: Wallet, bundles, gift cards and promo codes became one owner-controlled switch, off by default
entries.why: The salon is taking orders by phone for now. Customers should be able to browse and book without any money moving inside the app, but the feature has to come back intact later without rebuilding it.
changes: Added a featureWallet flag that follows the existing config pattern: config.json provides the default, the owner's choice is stored in data/db.json and overrides it.
Added an on/off control in Админ → ⚙️ Тохиргоо → Нэмэлт боломж, visible to the owner only. Staff accounts get 403.

Closed the wallet endpoints server-side when the flag is off rather than only hiding the interface. Top-up, redeem, bundle purchase and gift card purchase return 403 feature_disabled; list endpoints return an empty array so an old cached app degrades quietly.
Admin-side gating runs after authentication, so an unauthenticated request still gets 401 rather than an empty list.
Bookings fall back to pay-at-salon when the flag is off, even if the client asks to pay from a balance.
Hid the wallet tab, balance displays, top-up and gift shortcuts in the customer app, and the balance stat, wallet adjustment and bundles section in the admin client profile.
Website copy switches to wallet-free wording via _nw i18n variants, and wallet-only sections carry data-wallet so they stay hidden.
entries.data_impact: None. Balances, bundles and gift cards stay in data/db.json when the flag is off and reappear when it is switched back on.
verified: Wallet off: booking requesting payWith=balance recorded as salon, balance untouched
Wallet off: POST /api/topup and /api/redeem return 403, GET /api/transactions returns []
Wallet off: unauthenticated /api/admin/promos returns 401, owner POST returns 403
Wallet on: top-up returns 200, bundles load, balance payment deducts correctly
Toggled off again: stored balance survived, setting persisted to data/db.json

entries.author: Claude (Cowork session)
entries.summary: Image uploads are downscaled in the browser and the size ceiling is enforced on the server
entries.why: Disk on the host is the one resource billed by the gigabyte. Progress photos were already resized before upload, but the server trusted the client and accepted up to 8 MB per image. Product photos are coming, and a catalogue uploaded straight from a phone camera would cost roughly twenty times what a web-sized one does.
changes: Added public/assets/imgtools.js, a shared client-side helper: File to canvas at a 1280px longest side, EXIF rotation honoured, then JPEG encoding with quality stepped down until the result fits a 600KB budget.
The progress-photo path now delegates to that helper instead of carrying its own copy of the resize logic, so every future upload path gets the same treatment.
Loaded the helper on both the app and the admin page, ready for product photos.
Added imageDims() to server.js: reads width and height straight out of PNG, JPEG and WebP headers with no image library, keeping the project dependency-free.
Added checkImage(), now used by POST /api/photos: rejects anything under 100 bytes, over 2 MB, or with a longest side over 2000px, returning 413 image_too_large.
Added err.image_too_large and err.feature_disabled strings in Mongolian and English.
entries.data_impact: None. Existing stored photos are untouched; the limits apply to new uploads only.
verified: JPEG 800x600 accepted (200), JPEG 2400x1200 rejected (413)
PNG 100x100 accepted (200), PNG 1999x1999 accepted at the boundary (200), PNG 3000x200 rejected (413)
2.2 MB payload rejected (413)
/assets/imgtools.js served, and referenced by both /app and /admin

entries.author: Claude (Claude Code session)
entries.summary: Super admin role, account management and owner-editable contact details
entries.why: The owner should run the salon (services, products, texts) while one separate account controls feature switches and every login.
changes: New superadmin role (default 80000000 / super123; the config.json PIN also opens it). Only it toggles the wallet and creates, edits, re-roles, resets or blocks accounts.
Owner edits address, phones, email and Facebook link in Админ → Тохиргоо; values are stored in db.settings and override config.json.
Admin sessions are re-checked against the account on every request, so role changes and blocks apply immediately.
New Products tab for the 'What we use' items.
entries.data_impact: Adds a superadmin user to existing databases on first start. Nothing is removed.
verified: Owner gets 403 on accounts and the wallet switch
Blocked staff session returns 401 at once
Existing db gains the super admin on restart

entries.author: Claude (Claude Code session)
entries.summary: Website and app redesigned for phone and desktop; FAQ, products and reviews refreshed
entries.why: The app only had a phone layout and the website buried reviews and FAQ at the bottom.
changes: Website: reviews moved right after services; phone gets a burger menu, a Call/Book bar and swipeable rows; desktop gets grids and sticky side panels.
App: sidebar and two-column layouts from 1024px; booking stepper; split login screen; FAQ view; /app#book=<serviceId> deep link.
FAQ moved into the database (16 answers, owner-editable in Админ → ❓ Асуулт).
Products gained a short benefit label; public reviews expose a star distribution and a booked-in-app badge.
Fixed the hidden tab bar and wallet tab still showing.
entries.data_impact: Adds db.faq. Refreshes default product texts only where the owner never edited them.
verified: No horizontal scroll at 390/820/1366px
Booking completed end to end on phone and desktop
Edited product text survives the migration

entries.author: Claude (Claude Code session)
entries.summary: Staff create customer records with description, repeat-service plans and shared notes
entries.why: Customers mostly call; staff need to record who they served without the customer installing the app.
changes: Create a customer by name + phone, no password. Registering later with that phone claims the record and its history.
Staff-only description, record-a-visit, repeat plans every N days with due/overdue flags, notes shared with the team by default.
entries.data_impact: New optional fields on customer users (staffDesc, noLogin, plans) and on notes (shared). Existing notes stay private.
verified: Owner sees shared notes but not private ones
Customer claims record by registering and sees their visit
Customer never receives staffDesc

entries.author: Claude (Claude Code session)
entries.summary: Details from the Facebook page: booking phones, CL Medisys items, men's FAQ
entries.why: The owner asked to use what is already published on the salon's Facebook page.
changes: bookingPhones setting shown as tap-to-call links on the website and in the app.
CL Medisys skincare and micro-needle device added to Products.
Men's FAQ answer mentions face, scalp and back gua sha and massage.
entries.data_impact: Adds the two products and refreshes the men's answer once, only if still default.
verified: Items and answer appear on an existing database after restart

entries.author: Claude (Claude Code session)
entries.summary: Booking phones list no longer contains the mistyped 91113859
entries.why: The Facebook post swapped two digits of the main number; the correct number is 9111 3958, which is already the main phone.
changes: Default bookingPhones is now 99083070, 96674700.
INFO-TO-FILL-IN.md links the post that carries the typo and records that hours stay 10:00–19:00.
entries.data_impact: None unless the owner had already saved bookingPhones in Settings; a saved value still wins.
verified: config.json parses; /api/config returns the new list

entries.author: Claude (Claude Code session)
entries.summary: Fast phone booking: number → service → time, and unknown numbers create the client
entries.why: Orders arrive by phone and staff keep them in Google Calendar. The system is only worth switching to if taking a phone booking is faster than typing a calendar event, and the client list should build itself from that work.
changes: Admin header button 📞 Захиалга and the N key open a three-step booking dialog; the empty-cell calendar action opens the same dialog prefilled.
Phone field searches as you type (4+ digits); an exact 8-digit match picks the client and preselects the service they booked most recently.
GET /api/admin/lookup (phone or name type-ahead) and GET /api/admin/free (free start times per therapist/service/day; staff only their own).
POST /api/admin/walkin now turns an unknown 8-digit number into a client record (noLogin) and accepts an optional note, saved as a shared client note.
Bookings created this way are marked createdBy 'phone'.
entries.data_impact: New client records appear for every new phone number booked. Existing data unchanged.
verified: Staff books a new number in 5 inputs; the client record is created with noLogin
Typing a known number auto-selects the client and their last service
Calendar cell keeps its preset time and therapist; Enter submits
Staff calling /api/admin/free for another therapist gets 403

entries.author: Claude (Claude Code session)
entries.summary: Server clock pinned to Ulaanbaatar time
entries.why: Render runs in UTC, so between midnight and 08:00 Ulaanbaatar time the server still thought it was the previous day, and 'past slot' checks were 8 hours off.
changes: process.env.TZ defaults to Asia/Ulaanbaatar at the top of server.js, before any Date is created; an explicit TZ environment variable still overrides it.
entries.data_impact: None. Stored dates were always Ulaanbaatar wall-clock strings; only 'today/now' comparisons change.
verified: At 16:59 UTC the server treats 2026-10-01 as today and rejects 2026-09-30 as past

entries.author: Claude (Claude Code session)
entries.summary: Private Google Calendar subscription link per staff member (and a salon-wide one for the owner)
entries.why: Staff already live in Google Calendar. Instead of asking them to switch, bookings made here appear in the calendar they check.
changes: GET /cal/<40-hex token>.ics serves an iCalendar feed: confirmed and done bookings from 60 days back to 180 days ahead, plus blocked times; times in UTC (Ulaanbaatar is fixed UTC+8), RFC 5545 escaping and 75-octet folding.
Event title is client — service (plus therapist on the salon-wide feed); description carries the phone, price and the staff description of the client.
GET /api/admin/calfeed creates the caller's links on first use; POST /api/admin/calfeed/reset replaces them. Links are re-checked on every fetch, so blocked accounts lose theirs immediately.
Admin header button 📅 Google shows the links, copy buttons, the three setup steps and the refresh-lag caveat.
entries.data_impact: Adds db.calFeeds (token → user, scope). Nothing else changes.
verified: Booking at 14:00 appears as DTSTART 06:00Z
No line over 75 octets, CRLF only, commas/semicolons escaped
Old link 404 after reset; unknown token 404
Staff get no salon-wide link

entries.author: Claude (Claude Code session)
entries.summary: Directions button from a mapUrl setting, and share previews (OpenGraph + LocalBusiness data) on the home page
entries.why: Links shared on Facebook/Messenger should render with an image and description, and Google should understand the page as a local beauty salon. A directions button is only useful once the real Google Business Profile link exists.
changes: New mapUrl setting (config.json default empty, owner-editable in Админ → Тохиргоо, https only). The website's '🧭 Замаа олох' link and the app's Location row render only when it is set; the old address-search link is gone.

The server injects og:* tags, a canonical link and schema.org BeautySalon JSON-LD (address, phone, email, opening hours from the settings, map link, Facebook) into the home page head, built from the live settings and the request's public host.
og:image uses the 512px app icon for now; a 1200×630 photo would give a larger preview.
verified: Home HTML carries og tags with https://bguasha.com URLs behind a proxy
JSON-LD parses and includes postalCode 16020
Directions hidden until mapUrl is saved; javascript: URL rejected

entries.author: Claude (Claude Code session)
entries.summary: Setup-health warnings for the owner: missing persistent disk and default credentials
entries.why: It is unconfirmed whether Render has a persistent disk; without one every account and booking is wiped on deploy or idle restart. Default credentials (PIN 1234, owner123, super123, demo and example accounts) are still live and the PIN sits in a public config file.
changes: The server records the database creation time and a boot counter, and detects whether data/ sits on a different device than the app (a mounted disk) when running on Render.
GET /api/admin/health (owner/super admin) returns storage info and warnings: no_disk, default_pin, default_super, default_owner, example_staff, demo_customer.
A warning card at the top of the admin panel lists each item with the exact fix, until it is fixed.
ADMIN_PIN environment variable overrides the config.json PIN; SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD sets the super admin's first password.
HOSTING-GUIDE.md: secrets step and the exact disk mount path /opt/render/project/src/data.
entries.data_impact: Adds db.meta.createdAt, boots and lastBoot. For databases created before this change createdAt is the first start with this version.
verified: RENDER=true without a mounted disk shows all six warnings
With ADMIN_PIN and SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD set, PIN 1234 is rejected and only three warnings remain
Boot counter increments and createdAt is kept across restarts
Staff get 403 on /api/admin/health

entries.author: Claude (Claude Code session)
entries.summary: Booking and block times stored as explicit +08:00 instants
entries.why: Availability has to compare exact instants. Bookings stored a bare date + time, and 'today' and weekdays came from the server's own clock and time zone (Render runs in UTC), so the salon's day could shift by eight hours.
changes: Bookings and blocks store startsAt / endsAt as ISO strings with an explicit +08:00 offset (e.g. 2026-10-02T14:00:00+08:00). No bare local time is stored.
Every date calculation (today, weekday, adding days, the customer app's one-hour lead time, plan due dates, the calendar subscription feed) uses fixed UTC+08:00 and ignores the process time zone.
API responses still include date, time and minutes, derived from startsAt / endsAt, so existing screens and the customer app keep working.
entries.data_impact: One-time migration on the first start (meta.scheduleVersion 1): each booking's date/time/minutes becomes startsAt/endsAt and gets machines: []; each block's date/time becomes startsAt/endsAt one slot long; the old keys are removed; services get uses: []. Take a Backup (admin header) before deploying.
verified: npm test: a legacy database with bare date/time bookings and blocks migrates to +08:00 instants and the old bookings still block new ones
npm test: every stored booking, machine hold and block matches YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+08:00
The whole suite runs with the server process in TZ=America/Los_Angeles

entries.author: Claude (Claude Code session)
entries.summary: Machine registry and machine-aware availability: two staff can never book the same machine at overlapping times
entries.why: The salon has a limited number of machines (e.g. one HIFU, two steamers). Bookings only checked the therapist, so two people could book the same machine for the same time.
changes: config.json → machines: [{id, name, units, bufferMinutes}], shipped as clearly marked PLACEHOLDER entries; bookingStepMinutes (default 15) sets the staff booking grid. Invalid entries are logged and ignored.
Services declare uses: [{machine, minutes, startOffset}] — the part of the treatment that uses each machine. Validated: known machine, no duplicates, window inside the service, at most 4.

A booking reserves its therapist (1 unit) for the whole appointment and each machine from start+startOffset for minutes, plus that machine's bufferMinutes. Intervals are half-open, so back-to-back is allowed. Overlapping reservations are counted per resource (peak concurrency) and the booking is refused when any resource would exceed its units.
Only confirmed and done bookings hold anything; cancelling releases the therapist and machines at once; restoring a cancelled or no-show booking, or reassigning it, re-checks.
The check runs again inside a serialized write (check, mutate and save with no await in between), for customer bookings, staff bookings, restores, reassignments and blocks.
Bookings keep a snapshot of their machine windows, so later edits to a service don't move existing reservations.
GET /api/admin/free returns only the start times that pass the full therapist + machine check; a refused booking returns 409 {error: 'slot_taken', reason: 'staff_busy' | 'machine_busy'}.
The customer app's slots use the same engine.
Owner warnings: machines_placeholder and service_machine_problem.
entries.data_impact: Bookings gain machines: [{machine, startsAt, endsAt, releasesAt}] (existing bookings: none). Services gain uses (existing: none, meaning no machine).
verified: npm test (node --test, no dependencies) against the real server with 1 HIFU and 2 steamers: acceptance cases 1–6 pass, plus cleaning buffers, a two-machine service and a service with no machine
Races: two staff for the last HIFU → exactly one succeeds; five at once → one; three for two steamers → two
Mutation checks: moving the check outside the serialized write makes the race test fail; treating the end as inclusive makes the back-to-back test fail

entries.author: Claude (Claude Code session)
entries.summary: Staff can no longer see each other's schedules through any page or API call; own-day, block and machine-board endpoints
entries.why: Each therapist's day view must be private, enforced on the server for every request.
changes: Staff requests are filtered to their own bookings everywhere: calendar, overview, booking status, client list, client card (history, plan due dates, reviews), phone lookup, free times and the calendar feed. Another staff member's booking id answers 404, like an id that does not exist.
New GET /api/admin/myday — one day of the caller's own bookings and blocks (the owner may pass staffId).

New GET /api/admin/machines and GET /api/admin/machines/board — the shared board shows only each machine's busy windows, units in use and cleaning time; no booking id, client, phone, service or staff name.
Blocks: any length (from–to, up to 24:00). Staff block only themselves; a block reserves the therapist only, never a machine, and is refused if it overlaps their own booking.
Restoring a booking to confirmed now re-checks availability; before, it could create a double booking.
verified: npm test, acceptance 7: B gets 404 on A's booking id; A's bookings are absent from B's my-day, calendar, overview, client list, client card and lookup; B gets 403 for A's free times, for blocking A's time and for deleting A's block; B's calendar feed has only B's bookings
npm test: the board contains no client names, phone numbers, service or staff names, or ids

entries.author: Claude (Claude Code session)
entries.summary: Logins last 60 days from their last use; signing out ends the session on the server
entries.why: Staff use the panel from their phone's home screen and should not have to log in again every visit. A long-lived login then has to be revocable.
changes: Admin and customer sessions expire 60 days after their last use (sliding). lastSeenAt is written at most once an hour per session.
New POST /api/admin/logout deletes the current admin session.
entries.data_impact: Existing sessions get lastSeenAt = now on the first start. Sessions unused for 60 days are removed the next time they are presented. Customer sessions previously never expired.
verified: npm test: a session last used 59 days ago still works and one last used 61 days ago gets 401
npm test: after logout that token gets 401 while the same person's other session still works
